visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with three individuals sitting behind a white desk in a bright studio. They gesture enthusiastically at the camera. (2) A transition occurs where a rectangular overlay appears in the center showing an animated scene of Crayon Shin-chan. The characters behind the desk maintain their positions but change their facial expressions to look contemplative and then surprised, pointing towards the overlay. (3) The visual shifts to show a manga panel from Demon Slayer featuring character overlays. The background studio remains visible, and the three people continue to react with exaggerated facial expressions, such as wide eyes and open mouths, while holding various anime figures and cards. (4) A series of manga panels showing the character Ran Mouri from Detective Conan appear sequentially, illustrating her hairstyle changes over time. The creators interact with the graphics by nodding and pointing. (5) The camera focuses on the table which is now filled with various packaged products including 'KartRider' toy boxes, gift boxes with red ribbons, and character cards. The man in the center holds up a small figurine. (6) A screen recording or graphic overlay shows the LINE WEBTOON interface and promotional posters for manga series. The creators are seen in a split-screen or inset, continuing their energetic presentation. (7) The final phase shows the three people cheering together as colorful confetti graphics fall across the screen. They hold up products and wave to the camera in a coordinated manner.
